placement.rationale: Mid-cap placement balances the source-sized fractions beside letters and mixed-height figures. Top alignment lowers the denominators more heavily; bottom alignment raises the numerators close to the existing ascent. Center placement retains the source dimensions and offers balanced mixed-text placement within existing metrics.
placement.historical_limit: The charts do not establish a co-set historical text baseline. Row center 350 and 35-unit sidebearings are explicit modern layout choices. Full source physical dimensions and between-form differences remain.
placement.source_gap: Seek matching six-point fractions or symbols co-set with letters or ordinary figures to establish historical baseline placement.

row_review.note: Both native BYU rows reviewed with top, center and bottom overlays. Each fit uses nine fraction centers at threshold 150, excluding shorter cent and percent. One row transform preserves relative positions; original six/seven labels remain explicit.

regular-fraction-6-atf-handy-byu-1897-0.method: Estimate row skew from whole-form ink-box centers at threshold 150. Every row fit excludes the shorter cent/percent. All available traced fractions determine the row fit; their exact IDs and count are recorded. Use one row translation, preserving differences between forms. This is not a measured text baseline.

regular-fraction-7-atf-handy-byu-1897-0.method: Estimate row skew from whole-form ink-box centers at threshold 150. Every row fit excludes the shorter cent/percent. All available traced fractions determine the row fit; their exact IDs and count are recorded. Use one row translation, preserving differences between forms. This is not a measured text baseline.

atf-handy-1897.method: Independent common-capital and repeated-footer physical scale.

atf-handy-byu-1897.method: Reviewed whole-form width/height fit of six-labelled impressions to matching Handy six-point fractions and symbols. One isotropic page scale also applies to reviewed same-size seven-labelled witnesses; no resizing by nominal point label.

common_capital_fit.method: One isotropic least-squares fit to common capitals after measured row rotation; independent repeated footer transfers scale to fraction chart. Wider10/12pt S forms remain comparison-only and do not set scale.

footer_scale_transfer.method: Map 26 footer projection groups using threshold 170, combining the overlapping R/S pair in FOUNDERS. Measure ink bounds independently at five thresholds. Fit one isotropic 2D similarity transform to matched group centers. No fraction dimensions enter the fit.

quality_decisions: All 539 distinct threshold trials (540 displayed evaluations, one cached duplicate confirmation) from 98 whole impressions were reviewed on 37 PDF pages. All 132 six/seven native cells across six books were previously reviewed.
The largest grayscale BYU six-labelled impressions supply quarter, half, one-third, cent and percent at threshold 150, and two-thirds at 130. All figures and counters are intact.

The BYU seven-labelled three-quarters at 110 is a clearer same-size witness with three separate complete parts and a closed four. Six/seven paired physical dimensions and native construction match; original seven label retained, without resizing. The six-labelled alternative at 75–95 has a ragged slash foot and joins the four at 100.

BYU six-labelled seven-eighths at threshold 80 retains four whole ink parts and both counters. At 50 the seven and eight break; at 70 the slash foot is ragged; at 90 the lower slash contacts the eight. The seven-labelled impression retains that contact throughout usable thresholds.
One-eighth, three-eighths and five-eighths remain source-quality gaps; no unverified separation is drawn and no parts are assembled.

American Line cent is excluded from source-scale fitting and substitution because pale lower strokes make its measured dimensions unreliable. Expanded native context rejects a distinct short-cent interpretation; the clean BYU cent is retained.

One isotropic page scale is fitted from six-labelled whole forms to the independently established Handy six-point scale; the same page scale applies to the seven-labelled quality witness. No form is compressed or stretched.
identity_limit: Matched construction and proportional dimensions support grouping; identical historical punches or matrices are not established.

source_quality_gaps.⅛: Six/seven-labelled BYU impressions retain slash/eight contacts at thresholds 70–190; threshold 50 breaks the slash or the eight. New York, LOC and American Line close the eight only while the slash joins it. Seek an intact same-size whole impression; do not borrow or draw the missing separation.
source_quality_gaps.⅜: Six/seven-labelled BYU and Handy impressions join the lower slash to three and upper slash to eight. Pale New York, LOC and American Line impressions break the eight or slash before those contacts clear. No intact whole impression with resolved separations selected.
source_quality_gaps.⅝: Six/seven-labelled BYU impressions retain both slash/figure contacts; lowering thresholds introduces counter breaks or a five defect. The American Line five is broken until the parts merge, and New York/LOC also retain contacts at usable thresholds. Seek a clearer whole impression.

paired_label_evidence.method: Native pixel dimensions and translation-only binary overlap within each book. No individual scaling, rotation or deformation. Thresholds are the original mapping thresholds; differences include ink, wear and scan sampling.
paired_label_evidence.limit: Dimension and ink overlap do not establish identical physical matrices. Accept identity only with the native design review.
paired_label_evidence.decision: Six- and seven-labelled fraction constructions and native physical dimensions match on the retained page. A clearer seven-labelled impression may therefore serve as a whole six-point witness. Preserve its original label and use the same physical page scale without a nominal-point-size adjustment.
